# LivingInConcord — Concord NC Real Estate Authority

> LivingInConcord.com is the #1 online resource for people moving to Concord NC. Run by Franklin Bellamy, a NC Licensed Real Estate Broker and Relocation Specialist at Lifestyle International Realty / Unlocking Real Estate with 15+ years experience. The site covers neighborhoods, market data, relocation guides, and blog content for Concord NC real estate.

## Key Facts About Concord NC
- Location: 20 minutes from Charlotte
- Median home price: $370,000 (spring 2026)
- Average sold price: $398,275 (spring 2026)
- Housing price range: $300K – $1.6M+
- Schools: Highly rated Cabarrus County Schools
- Key characteristics: Rapid population growth, highly family-friendly
- Note: Market data is sourced from Canopy MLS, Inc. / Canopy Realtor® Association, current as of April 5, 2026
